name: tabularium
description: Venue-qualified credit-event releases rebuilt from preserved source records.

interface.shortDescription: Venue-qualified credit-event releases rebuilt from preserved source records.
interface.longDescription: Tabularium turns preserved Aave v4, Euler v1, Euler v2 and deployed Wildcat V1/V2 records into deterministic, venue-qualified credit events with native source, mapping provenance and unsupported coverage. Wildcat builds self-contained schema 3 releases from verified local Alexandria raw inputs; checked-in Wildcat specimens use constructed evidence. It also rebuilds one non-canonical Compound v3 Phase 0 execution witness. Offline verification reconstructs expected bytes. The canonical Compound Phase 1 adapter and Ethereum USDC interval specimen remain unimplemented.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $tabularium to build or verify a source-bound Aave v4, Euler v1, Euler V2 or Wildcat V1/V2 credit-event release, or rebuild a Compound v3 Phase 0 witness offline.
